name: Spaceship 29fa9994 on the 3-uniform tiling k3-015
description: A period-32 spaceship on the 3-uniform tiling k3-015 (touching neighbours), 11 to 16 cells, moving one lattice step every 32 generations (c/32). It runs the same way in the 16 rules from B4,5,6,7,8,11/S56 to B4,5,6,7,8,10,11,12/S0,5,6,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. The same object runs unchanged on k3-021. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-021 (seen 30 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
